description: Server-side compact flowchart generation. Add a `detail` parameter ('overview'|'standard'|'detailed', default 'standard') that controls node grouping in flowGenerator.js. In 'standard' mode, consecutive PROCESS IR nodes are grouped into a single FlowNode (label: 'Statements (N)' if N>=2, or keep single as-is) rather than emitting one node per statement. In 'overview' mode, only structural nodes (DECISION, LOOP, FUNCTION_DEF, START, END) are emitted. In 'detailed' mode no grouping occurs. Also add a `code` field to FlowNode carrying the raw source. Add a smarter generateLabel() helper in flowNode.js. Expose `detail` through analyzerService.js and routes/flowchart.js. Finally, add a new POST /api/flowchart/analyze/selection route that accepts {code, language, startLine, endLine, detail, filePath}, parses the full file, finds the smallest meaningful IR container for the cursor position, builds a sub-IR, and returns a compact flowchart for just that selection. Cache parsed IRs in a module-level Map keyed by filePath:djb2hash to avoid re-parsing unchanged files.
steps: 1. Modify server/analyzer/flow/flowNode.js: (a) Add a `code` field to createFlowNode (accept code param, default ''), storing it alongside label. (b) Add exported function generateLabel(type, rawCode) that produces short human-readable labels: assignment with total/sum/count/result/avg in varName → 'Calculate {varName}'; input read → 'Read Input'; print/log/output → 'Print Output'; condition → 'Check: {cond truncated 40ch}'; loop → 'Loop: {cond truncated 40ch}'; function_def → 'Function: {name}'; function_call → 'Call: {name}'; return → 'Return {value}'; generic assignment (contains '=' not '==' or '!=') → 'Set {varName}'; fallback → first 50 chars of rawCode. Do NOT rename the existing createFlowNode export signature — just add code as a new optional field.

2. Modify server/analyzer/flow/flowGenerator.js: (a) Add `detail` parameter to generateFlowchartFromIR (default 'standard'). (b) In translateSequence, for the PROCESS case: instead of immediately emitting a node, peek ahead to collect consecutive PROCESS nodes. In 'standard' mode: group consecutive PROCESS items (run of 2+) into one FlowNode with label 'Statements (N)' and code listing first statement; single isolated PROCESS nodes are emitted normally. In 'overview' mode: skip ALL PROCESS, INPUT, OUTPUT, FUNCTION_CALL, BREAK, CONTINUE nodes — only DECISION, LOOP, FUNCTION_DEF, RETURN, THROW, SWITCH, TRY_CATCH survive. In 'detailed' mode: emit every node individually as today. (c) In FUNCTION_DEF case: if total nodes would exceed 80 after adding this function's body, collapse the function body to a single FUNCTION node with label 'Function: {name}(...)' instead of recursing — add a pre-check helper countIRNodes(body) that recursively counts nodes. (d) Pass the `detail` param recursively to all translateSequence calls. (e) Use generateLabel from flowNode.js to create labels, storing the raw IR label/expression in the `code` field.
3. Modify server/analyzer/analyzerService.js: Add `detail` parameter (default 'standard') to analyzeCodeFlowchart. Forward it to generateFlowchartFromIR call on line ~37.

4. Modify server/routes/flowchart.js: (a) In the existing POST /analyze handler, extract `detail` from req.body and pass it to analyzeCodeFlowchart. (b) Add a new route handler: POST /analyze/selection. Body: {code, language, startLine, endLine, detail, filePath}. Steps in the handler: validate code is string; detect language; check isLanguageSupported; look up cache (module-level Map, key=`${filePath}:${djb2(code)}`); if miss, call parseToIR and store in cache; walk irNodes to find the smallest IR container enclosing [startLine,endLine] using a findSelectionContext(irNodes, startLine, endLine) helper function (defined in this file); call generateFlowchartFromIR with subIR and detail; normalizeNodes/normalizeEdges; return same shape as /analyze. The findSelectionContext helper walks irNodes recursively: if an item is FUNCTION_DEF and lineStart<=startLine and lineEnd>=endLine, return item.body; if DECISION and same range, return [item]; if LOOP and same range, return [item]; if nothing found, fall back to all irNodes sliced to the 5 nearest lines above and below startLine. Include the djb2() hash function inline (standard djb2: seed=5381, for each char: hash = ((hash<<5)+hash)+charCode). Add 'POST /api/flowchart/analyze/selection' to the availableEndpoints list in server/index.js.

5. Verify server starts clean: cd server && node index.js — must print startup banner with no crash. Then smoke-test the new endpoint: POST /api/flowchart/analyze with a simple if/else JS snippet — confirm nodes.length is 5 or 6 (START, decision, two branches, END), not 50+.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/flowchart/analyze returns <=6 nodes for a simple if/else JavaScript snippet (START + decision + YES branch + NO branch + END)
POST /api/flowchart/analyze with `detail:'standard'` on a 50-line file with only assignments returns <=15 nodes (consecutive assignments grouped)
POST /api/flowchart/analyze/selection endpoint exists, returns 200 with {success:true, nodes, edges}
POST /api/flowchart/analyze/selection with startLine inside an if-block returns only that if/else subtree nodes, not the entire file
node index.js starts without crash after changes
All existing /analyze behavior is preserved for detail:'detailed' (no grouping, same as current)
verification: cd c:\Users\Aditi\codemind_mega\server && node index.js — must start on port 4000 without any runtime error

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/flowchart/analyze/selection -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"code":"let x=1;\nlet y=2;\nif(x>y){console.log(x);}else{console.log(y);}","language":"javascript","startLine":3,"endLine":3,"detail":"standard"}' — confirm success:true and nodes present
findings: All steps implemented and verified. generateLabel() in flowNode.js produces human-readable labels (e.g. 'Check: marks >= 40', 'Print Output'). flowGenerator.js standard mode groups consecutive PROCESS IR nodes into 'Statements (N)' reducing node count significantly. detail='detailed' preserves original one-node-per-statement behavior. The /analyze/selection route caches parsed IR by filePath:djb2(code), uses findSelectionContext to return only the nearest meaningful sub-IR for the cursor position, and returns compact flowcharts. Server starts cleanly on port 4000. Note: the JS adapter produces empty trueBranch/falseBranch for console.log inside if/else — that is pre-existing adapter behavior, not a regression introduced here.
